_comment: AD-9. One source of truth for where images come from, read by bin/check-images.mjs
and by tools/build_site.py, tools/gen_sitemaps.py and tools/fetch_images.py so the
generator and the checker can never disagree about the host.
oldHost is new.rexdalemobilewash.ca, not www.rexdalemobilewash.ca. This migration
keeps the domain and changes the hosting, so www. is the destination, not a hotlink —
reporting it would flag all 19 pages on every build and mean nothing. new. is the
WordPress staging host: it has no DNS record at all, so any reference to it is already
dead. A photo still served from www. is caught anyway, by the off-host rule: www. is
not the canonical host and is not in allow, so it fails the build.
